about_the_game: A project born from passion and boredom, Just Another Boomer Shooter leaves its predecessor in the dust. Run, Shoot and style on your foes in this satirical homage to classic corridor-style boomer shooters. UltraDoom Boltgun, if you will. Blending a unique style with flash-age inspired animation, this game sends you back to 2015, when fidget spinners and MLG montages ruled the internet, and when Vine was our TikTok. Race through multiple levels inspired by old flash titles and boomer shooter games to achieve the fastest time, or try to find all the hidden collectibles. Just Another Boomer Shooter plans to launch in 2026.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
